id: title:gantoine:gate the golden snapshot bake on cd deploy enabled

review.posthog_relevance: Changes CI execution conditions for the 'Render agent skills' and 'Bake and promote' jobs, potentially reducing resource consumption and execution time when the broader CD deployment workflow is disabled.
review.reason: Adds a dependency on the CD_DEPLOY_ENABLED workflow variable before the HOG_TASKS_GOLDEN_ENABLED check. This narrows the execution condition of resource-heavy CI jobs, potentially saving time and resources. This is a localized maintenance and optimization change.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the current state of the CD deployment workflow and the frequency of these jobs; no runtime metrics or adoption data are provided. The score is assigned based solely on the observed code change, not on demonstrated outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks from the same workflow file. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 are treated as one group. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a dependency on the CD_DEPLOY_ENABLED workflow variable before the HOG_TASKS_GOLDEN_ENABLED check, while retaining the master branch and golden-enabled checks.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the execution condition of the 'Render agent skills' and 'Bake and promote' CI jobs. These jobs will now only run if the CD deployment workflow is explicitly enabled, not just if the golden snapshot task is enabled. This could prevent unnecessary execution of these resource-heavy jobs if the broader deployment workflow is disabled, potentially saving CI time and resources.
